template: multiply(zscore(winsorize(vec_avg({likelihood_score}) - ts_mean(vec_avg({likelihood_score}), 30) * ((vec_avg({exit_price}) / vec_avg({openprice})) / ts_mean(vec_avg({exit_price}) / vec_avg({openprice}), 30)), std=4)), subtract(1, multiply(0.3, abs(ts_zscore(ts_std_dev(vec_avg({likelihood_score}), 60), 60)))))
